criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 3: 'Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels' and 'Ready and Retry are static images'; reaffirmed at line 9 'Keep the existing 16x16 canvas, static behavior'. src/queue-view.ts line 6 frames 1, line 9 cell [16,16]. Left open: nothing about canvas; construction inside the cell is open.
criterion_comparisons.literal_check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
criterion_comparisons.additions: none; 'no horizontal strip, no extra canvas' restates 16x16 single frame.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: A 64x16 strip or a 32x32 padded canvas would be rejected, and the source itself excludes both (line 3 and line 9).
criterion_comparisons.citation_check: Corrected pointers BRIEF [3,3], queue-view [6,6], [9,9] verified. Observation: line 9 of BRIEF also supports this check and is not cited; line 3 is sufficient, so no change requested.
criterion_comparisons.disposition: consistent; owner requirement; verdict.0 remains bound to the historical plan

criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 3 'Use transparent backgrounds' (reaffirmed line 9). Left open: alpha depth; partial alpha not restricted.
criterion_comparisons.literal_check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
criterion_comparisons.additions: 'no opaque matte, box or fringe' operationalizes transparency; explicitly permits partial alpha.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: A check with soft partially transparent edge pixels passes; a check on an opaque rounded plate fails and the source excludes it (the plate would be a background).

criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 9: 'Ready must visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion'; line 3: working must not look like success. src/queue.ts line 3 ok -> succeeded; src/queue-view.ts line 3 idle Start and line 6 succeeded Ready; assets/start.svg line 1 triangle. Left open: arm ratio, stroke, angle, colour count, plate.
criterion_comparisons.literal_check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion; it reads as completion rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
criterion_comparisons.additions: 'rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control' lists the other states from queue-view lines 3-7 and BRIEF lines 3 and 7; no ratio or stroke restriction.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: A thin 1-px check with a 2:3 arm ratio passes; a symmetric V is rejected by the owner's own word 'asymmetrical', not by the specialist.
criterion_comparisons.citation_check: Six corrected pointers verified: queue.ts [3,3], queue-view [3,3] and [6,6], BRIEF [3,3] and [9,9], start.svg [1,1]. Historical [1,4] and [3,11] replaced.

criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 3 'readable silhouettes' and 'Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel'; src/queue-view.ts line 9 scale 3, nearest, background #172336. Left open: any numeric contrast or stroke threshold.
criterion_comparisons.literal_check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.
criterion_comparisons.additions: 'no essential detail lost into the panel colour' is the readability outcome restated; #172336 is the consumer observation, correctly labelled.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: A darker navy-blue check that vanishes at 1x fails; a mid-blue readable mark passes. The specialist's 7.41:1 contrast figure is retained as a diagnostic, not a threshold.
criterion_comparisons.disposition: consistent; owner requirement with consumer observation; verdict.3 unchanged

criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 3: 'the existing UI's cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required'; assets/start.svg line 1 fill #70b9ed is the only concrete cue. Left open: exact hex, tone count.
criterion_comparisons.literal_check: The dominant colour treatment visibly relates to the existing UI's cool blue accent as seen in assets/start.svg (#70b9ed). This is a visual relationship judgement, not an exact-hex or palette-count rule.
criterion_comparisons.additions: none beyond naming the cue; the check disclaims exact-hex and palette-count rules.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: A two-tone cool blue (#5aa9e6 with a lighter highlight) passes; a green check with one blue pixel fails under a reasonable reading of the brief itself.
criterion_comparisons.citation_check: Corrected pointers BRIEF [3,3], start.svg [1,1] verified. The delivered fill equals #70b9ed; the assessment correctly records exact equality as a fixture property, not a rule.
criterion_comparisons.disposition: consistent; owner requirement plus observation; verdict.4 unchanged

criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 3 'Create coherent pixel-art status assets' and line 5 'propose a representative status sample before expanding the family'. The owner does not define pixel-craft quality; this is expert judgment.
criterion_comparisons.literal_check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: clean pixel clusters and edges, no noisy stray pixels, blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused.
criterion_comparisons.additions: clean clusters/edges, no strays/blur/downscale artifacts, extensibility: all expert quality criteria.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: A brief-conforming but blurry downscaled check would fail this rule only. It is labelled authority proposal, scoped to this sample, and does not create family palette/alpha/construction rules; the assessment keeps the construction properties as accepted fixture properties, not requirements.
criterion_comparisons.citation_check: Corrected pointers BRIEF [3,3] and [5,5] verified (historical single [3,9] replaced by two exact pointers).
criterion_comparisons.disposition: consistent scoped expert choice; verdict.5 unchanged
